action_summary: Measure the cost of asking the compiled model, and make it a gate. New instrument canonical/tools/runtime_answer_receipt_v1.py times: load of the 13 MB artifact, wrap, find_source, route, find_any_source, the promotion lookup, and the composite 'can you do this, and where' question, over 12 queries derived from compiled capability ids x 40 repeats. Result: load 292 ms, find_source p95 0.39 ms, route p95 0.15 ms, composite p95 1.46 ms, promotion lookup 0.6 us, total 1.04 s, 0 model calls, 0 network calls, 0 prompt tokens -- FAST against budgets 2000 ms / 5 ms / 60 s. Alongside it: FRONTIER_RESEARCH_20261127_V4.md, which extracts the selection law from three 2026 sources (rerankers ineffective at 20 candidates and on at 50; SkillCorpus 22.6 vs 13.8 vs 14.9) and reconciles it with this repo's two dead routing results, and FRONTIER_LEAPFROG_PLAN_20261127_V4.md -- three plays (delete the gate, admit adapters by recorded execution at a 40% floor, gate every capability on latency) and a delete list longer than the build list. 5 tests pass.

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: THE VOCABULARY IS THE ARTIFACT. An effect is a computable object -- the set of relations that moved between two readings -- and a goal can only be stated, planned for and verified in relations the system carries. Experience of an atom whose effect no relation names is experience of nothing.
what_is_false_in_the_claim: that experiencing the most advanced action once installs it: mv was experienced in every cell of the probe table twice and still could not take the rename request
that repetition fixes an unstateable goal: a thousand observations of an invisible change are a thousand observations of nothing
that one demonstration identifies the rule: median 1037 surviving programs, 4 of 23 tasks identified
that an action list transfers: 0 of 20 held-out bugs at any budget; an action shape from one demonstration reaches 1-2 of 20
that any of this solves 'any computer use': the five relations are a grammar, not the world, and OSWorld 2.0's hardest phenomena need relations nobody wrote down
